project.title: Interactive Video for Network Scanning
project.description: For my multimedia project, I developed an interactive instructional video on network scanning and Nmap. The project combines a narrated instructional video created in CapCut with interactive learning activities developed in Articulate Storyline 360. This approach transforms a traditional narrated video into a more engaging learning experience by giving learners opportunities to interact with the content, answer questions, make choices, and receive feedback during the lesson.
